title: Blonde
creator: Frank Ocean
summary: Frank Ocean's second album, four years in the making. It sounds like memory feels.
personalNote: There's no album that sounds more like the interior of someone's mind. Ocean builds moods rather than songs — Nikes, Self Control, Nights. The sequencing is part of the meaning. I've listened to it beginning to end more times than I can count and it still feels new in different moods.
whyIReturn: Sounds different every time. Always the right album for whatever I'm feeling.
